title: Transcode Capability Inventory Matrix
problem: nako-transcode has stage-aware hardware capability records but the observable FFmpeg capability inventory remains focused on the first H.264/AAC path, which leaves future HDR, HEVC/AV1, subtitle burn-in, and operator diagnostics without a richer evidence layer.

evidence.summary: Opened a transcode-only capability inventory lane that can run beside HDR HTP-030 while staying out of pipeline selection, FFmpeg command planning, server routes, API DTOs, and release packaging.
Added optional bitstream-filter stage evidence for h264_mp4toannexb and tests proving missing optional bitstream-filter evidence does not change HLS pipeline selection.

Added optional decoder, encoder, filter, tone-map, and subtitle burn-in inventory facts and tests proving listed or missing broader facts remain evidence-only and do not change HLS pipeline selection.

Accepted planner review and fresh verification evidence, merged broader capability inventory facts into main, closed the lane, and split hardware tone-map execution, HEVC/AV1 output, subtitle burn-in, Admin/release reporting, and HLS lifecycle/resource admission as follow-ons.

continue_policy.notes: Workstream complete. Open follow-on lanes for hardware tone-map execution, HEVC/AV1 output policy, subtitle burn-in, Admin/Public capability reporting, release hardware matrices, or HLS lifecycle/resource admission.
